scopes.name: sandbox_core
scopes.scope: The sandbox package API and CheckSpec, the agentkit.sandbox.v1 Agent protocol (Hello, Tools, Call, SyncTar, ExportTar) with checked-in generated code and make proto, the in-sandbox agent and sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd over stdio, proxy tools with their definition and execution guarantees, tar sync and export with validation, and the unisolated in-process local provider.

scopes.name: sandbox_rsync_sync
scopes.scope: LocalDir Sync and Export over a new Agent.Rsync stream, with github.com/gokrazy/rsync on both ends: the .gitignore dir-merge filter, ExcludeGit, IncludeIgnored, Delete and transfer statistics. Also the agent's refusal of unknown options and of paths outside the workspace, rsyncd.DontRestrict() on every server with a test that the host process stays unconfined, and the gokrazy/rsync ruling.

scopes.name: sandbox_landlock_agent
scopes.scope: agentkit-sandboxd applies its own go-landlock ruleset first thing in main: workspace, spill and HOME read-write, system directories read and execute, TCP denied under NetworkNone, never BestEffort. It reports the applied ABI in Hello and Sandbox.Agent(). Spec.RequireLandlock is enforced through CheckSpec by every provider, no host-side code path confines its own process, and go-landlock gets its ruling and a Linux-only build constraint.

scopes.name: sandbox_images
scopes.scope: The Debian-based base image and the FROM-scratch overlay image carrying agentkit-sandboxd at AgentPath, make targets to build them locally, and the release workflow that publishes ghcr.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandbox and agentkit-sandboxd for each version.

scopes.name: sandbox_podman
scopes.scope: The sandbox/podman provider, driving the podman or docker CLI through tools.RunArgv. It covers podman.Args(Spec) as a pure function with the full hardening set, the workspace volume, the GitRepo source and its init step, resources, TTL on both sides, labels and Reap, the micro-VM runtime option, the missing-agent error naming AgentPath and the COPY --from line, and the guard documentation on when AllowAll is reasonable.

scopes.name: sandbox_landlock_provider
scopes.scope: The sandbox/landlock provider: the agent as a Landlock-confined child process on Linux (ABI v4 or later, probed with a test seam), with the sandbox directory and marker, the environment, ExtraRO and ExtraRW, refusals of Resources, Image and NetworkAllowlist, the GitRepo init-step clone as a second child, and TTL, Close and Reap.

scopes.name: sandbox_gateway
scopes.scope: The Gateway gRPC service and the proxied Agent service, with the sandbox id carried in metadata. It covers the root-module client sandbox/gateway (gateway.Dial), and the server in a nested module at sandbox/gatewayd with cmd/agentkit-gateway, bearer-token authentication and a Podman backend, tested with client and server in one process over local.
